{{EventEnd|date = 13th of October 2019}} {{EventInfobox |image1 = GladiatorThumb.png |dates = 24 June 2019 – 13 October 2019 |previous_event = N/A |next_event = [[Area 51 Event|Area 51]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''SFOTH (Sword Fights on the Heights) Event''', also known as the '''Gladiator Event''', was the first event to be added to Tower Defense Simulator. This event introduced [[The Heights]], a remake of a classic Roblox game. The map was a remake of the {{RLinkG|47324|classic map}} made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/261/profile Shedletsky]. If you triumphed, you were awarded with the [[Gladiator]]. In this event, there were some exclusive enemies, as well as familiar enemies, such as the [[Slow]]. The event started on the 24th of June 2019, released with [[BETA v1.2]]. Before the MEGA Update, this event was active alongside the [[Area 51 Event]]. They also shared the same [[Elevators#Event Elevators|event elevator]]. The event ended on the 13th of October 2019, at the same time the [[Area 51 Event]] ended. ==Maps== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:Heights.png|200px|link=The Heights]] |- |[[The Heights]] |} ==Towers== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:Gladiator.png|200px|link=Gladiator]] |- |[[Gladiator]] |} ==Enemies== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:Slow.png|125px|link=Slow]] |[[File:Knight-0.png|125px|link=Knight (The Heights)]] |[[File:SpeedyZ.png|125px|link=Speedy]] |[[File:Zombie.png|125px|link=Normal]] |[[File:Boomer1-0.png|125px|link=Boomer 1]] |[[File:StoneViking-0.png|125px|link=Stone Viking]] |- |[[Slow]]
